title: O demak no pisalamaan 公園的活動
suggested_answer_amis:
I pisalamaan i, macidal a saemel ko fali.
'Aloman ko tamdaw i tini a misarakarakat a comikay a lipahak to cilimaway a romi'ad.
Ira ko mikeriday to waco, tada lipahak koya waco a mafekac.
Ira ko madakaway to fatikar a mita'elif toya i lidongay a lalan.
I rengorengosan i, miwi'awi' ko 'alomanay a miundo, tada 'arik'ik caira.
Malawla ko wawawawa a misalama, caay katerep ko tawa.
O fangcalay a pipahanhanan i ningri kina pala. Manga'ay a pasinoway to faloco', a mahapinang ko kafangcal no hekal ato 'orip ita.
suggested_answer_ch: 公園裡陽光明媚，許多人散步、慢跑、運動，享受戶外時光。有人遛狗、有人騎單車，孩子們嬉戲玩耍，處處充滿歡笑與活力，讓身心都感到放鬆與愉悅。

title: O ontokay no pitilidan 學校運動會
suggested_answer_amis:
Tada lipahak ko ontokay no pitilidan, 
misa'icel ko mitiliday a malalifet i kacomikayan, tahira tahini ko ngiha' no mipa'icelay i lawac. 
Yo mipatong a comikay, pacedi san a comikay ko milifetay a miala to lita'ang no kasacefang. 
O miki'araway a singsi ato mitiliday i, tano laha' san a mihemek, miwatawat to hata a hata a pahapinang to kilemel ato nika lacecay.
O caayay ka tawal a harateng konini.
suggested_answer_ch: 學校運動會熱鬧非凡，同學們在跑道上奮力競賽，場邊加油聲此起彼落。大家團結合作，發揮實力，展現運動精神，留下難忘回憶。

title: 沙灘上的快樂夏日
suggested_answer_amis:
Ma'edil ko cidal i lawac no riyar,
tada lipahak ko mato'asay, wawa ato kapah a misalama.
O roma i, misatafok, tatawa saan.
O roma i, mipatikeday a mitala to foting.
O roma i, midangoy i riyar a misalama, tada saepi'.
O roma i, mikalic to sapidangoy a pakalaing.
Maemin cangra a malipahak to nikafangcal no kaciherangan i riyar.

title: 一家人共耕田野
suggested_answer_amis:
Mataengad ko cidal i omah,
mapolong ko laloma'an a matayal.
O mato'asay i,
o roma mikangkang to sera,
o roma mi'anip ato mipaloma,
o roma mipitpit to dateng.
Minanam ko wawa i 'alaneng a mifotfot to dateng,
tatawa saan.\Mipadang ko kapah a micolo' to capox ato nilitodan,
tada ci'icel cangra. Mapapadang cangra a malalicay,
malipahak to nikaroray ato nikarimorak to kinaira,
pahapinang to nikafangcal no hekal.
suggested_answer_ch: 陽光灑落田野，大人們有的翻土整地，有的插秧播種，有的採收蔬菜。小孩們在田埂間學習拔蘿葡、摘菜，笑聲不斷。青年們協助搬運秧苗與收穫，活力四射。大家分工合作，彼此交流，享受勞動的樂趣與豐收的喜悦，感受大自然的美好與生活的充實。

title: 家庭溪邊樂趣時光
suggested_answer_amis:
Mataengad ko cidal i sa'owac,
tada lipahak ko mato'asay, wawa ato kapah a misalama.
O roma i, misalama to nanom ato mipasiyasing.
O roma i, miki'araw to ma'oripay.
O roma i, mipatiked.
O roma i, masasisi'si' to nanom, tatawa saan.
I hekal i, pahanhan ko faloco' naira a maemin,
mihamham to saepi'ay a nanom ato fangcalay a fali.
Miliwan to nikafangcal a hirateng, ato nika masasipatihi.
suggested_answer_ch: 陽光灑落溪流，大人、小孩與青年在溪邊盡情玩耍。有人戲水拍照，有人觀察生物，有人釣魚，有人打水仗，笑聲不斷。大自然中，大家放松心情，享受清涼溪水與新鮮空氣，留下美好回憶，感受自然的魅力與彼此的陪伴。
